ios.desc:
Zeitgeist is a calm 9:16 canvas for private stories. Capture a moment, add text or a photo, drop in a GIF, or set a live camera background. Record a quick voice memo - get a transcript when available. Everything syncs with iCloud, and you can offload originals to save space.

Features:
- 9:16 canvas with live camera or liquid background
- Text, photos, GIFs
- Voice memos with optional transcription
- Simple drag, pinch, and rotate gestures
- Grid and map views to browse your stories
- Export as image, video (when eligible), or text
- iCloud sync with on‑demand download and offload
- Apple Shortcut: “New Story”
- No feeds or followers; just your stories.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Zeitgeist – Stories for You

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

Recently, I looked at my old Instagram Stories and thought: Wow, Stories feel much more immersive than normal photos in my Gallery! The catch: I always have to publish them.

*Zeitgeist* fixes that. It’s a story camera for yourself. No followers, no posting. Just private stories you can look back on.

*What it does*

* Shoot in the familiar story format (photo/video), then add text, GIFs, Memos and more.
* View your stories on a Grid / Map
* Everything stays on your device/iCloud. No account. No feed.

*That's it*

The app is completely free; in the future I may add some paid cosmetic IAPs but nothing major like ads or feature blockers.

If you want to try it out: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/zeitgeist-stories-for-you/id6753016768
